What I changed
- Added a dedicated scroll container for long-strip mode in `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/reader/ReaderViewer.module.css#L9`.
- Added reusable scroll-container resolution in `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/reader/ReaderViewer.tsx#L54`.

- Updated page-sync scroll logic to use the same container for programmatic scrolling in `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/reader/ReaderViewer.tsx#L240`.
- Hooked long-strip styling via conditional class so only vertical mode gets internal scrolling in `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/reader/ReaderViewer.tsx#L292`.
- Added explicit no-scrollbar CSS module class support in `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/reader/ReaderViewer.module.css#L16`.

Why this fixes it
- Vertical mode now owns its own scrollable viewport, so wheel events have a valid scrolling element even while #root remains overflow hidden for the rest of the app layout.
- Scroll/page synchronization is now bound to that same viewport, so current-page detection remains accurate.
- Event handling is safer and cleaner than replacing onscroll globally.

 :

2. Added missing viewport and hide-scrollbar CSS classes in `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/reader/ReaderViewer.module.css#L9`:
